podcast.body: This album was ready by mid-June 2004, just 15 months after `Avalanche`. Matthew described it as an "experiment," influenced by his extensive listening to Buddy Holly and repeatedly watching *Hail! Hail! Rock 'n' Roll*. The recording process was intentionally primitive, recorded "live off the floor" with all musicians playing simultaneously in one room, a technique Matthew admired for its organic quality. "That record for me was more of an experiment."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Matt Good: In His Own Words - Part 2
